key_papers.title: Chameleon: Mixed-Modal Early-Fusion Foundation Models
key_papers.relevance: Primary reference for unified multimodal architecture
key_contributions: All modalities as discrete tokens (images, text, code)
Uniform Transformer trained end-to-end on interleaved data
State-of-the-art on image captioning and VQA benchmarks

key_papers.title: Visual Instruction Tuning (LLaVA)
key_papers.relevance: Reference for visual instruction tuning methodology
key_contributions: CLIP ViT + LLM connection via linear projection
End-to-end training for general-purpose visual assistant
key_papers.architecture_influence: Inspires understanding encoder design (CLIP ViT + projection)

key_papers.title: Sigmoid Loss for Language Image Pre-Training (SigLIP)
key_contributions: Pairwise sigmoid loss instead of softmax contrastive
Decouples batch size from loss computation
key_papers.architecture_influence: Supports CLIP encoder choice for understanding pathway

key_papers.title: Autoregressive Model Beats Diffusion: Llama for Scalable Image Generation (LlamaGen)
key_papers.relevance: Primary reference for autoregressive image generation
key_contributions: Vanilla autoregressive models achieve SOTA image generation
Llama architecture without vision-specific inductive biases
key_papers.architecture_influence: Validates VQ-VAE + Llama for generation pathway

method_validation.decoupled_encoding_rationale: Supported by LlamaGen (generation needs discrete tokens) and LLaVA (understanding benefits from CLIP features)
method_validation.unified_backbone_rationale: Supported by Chameleon (early fusion works) and LlamaGen (vanilla Llama architecture sufficient)
method_validation.token_based_approach_rationale: All four papers validate token-based representations for multimodal tasks

comparison_targets.target_performance: Match or exceed Chameleon on understanding, match LlamaGen on generation
